expected_claims.name: Firecrawl Government & Legal Index
expected_claims.tagline: Search an index of U.S. government and legal sources for AI-assisted research.
expected_claims.description: Firecrawl's Government & Legal Index searches government and legal sources including statutes, regulations and court opinions, with source links. The vendor documents public search API routes, the firecrawl_gov_search tool in its MCP server, CLI and SDK access, and AI-assistant connectors. Index search is described as credit-free; connector setup and usage limits have separate requirements. Verify the underlying issuer, jurisdiction, effective date and text before relying on a result. Documentation reviewed; this audit did not test account access or search completeness.
expected_claims.pricing_details: The vendor states index search uses no credits and the API works without a key to start. Its native Claude/ChatGPT connector setup describes a Firecrawl account; other MCP connection paths may differ. Confirm current limits and other service charges.

expected_claims.name: Supabase MCP Server
expected_claims.tagline: General developer connector for managing and querying Supabase projects.
expected_claims.description: Supabase’s official MCP server connects AI assistants to Supabase projects for database queries, schema/migration work and other enabled developer tools. It is general development tooling, not a legal database template or a client-permission-aware legal application. Project scoping, optional read-only mode and feature selection constrain access; write tools exist outside read-only configuration. Review Supabase’s security guidance before connecting company data. Documentation reviewed on October 27, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
expected_claims.pricing_details: Server code is open source; Supabase hosting/features, client subscriptions and operational costs are separate. Some tools create paid resources. Confirm current vendor plans.
